title: Wonders of Wildlife Stream Cleanup
seo_title: Wonders of Wildlife Stream Cleanup in Springfield, MO
description: This is a volunteer stream cleanup with Wonders of Wildlife and the Springfield Art Museum, where volunteers help clean Fassnight Creek and protect local wildlife habitat. Volunteers are invited to take part in the hands-on cleanup. It takes place Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 9:00 AM at the Springfield Art Museum Hatch Lawn, 1111 E Brookside Dr, Springfield, MO.
